Game Overview

In CrossCar, the core idea is straightforward: conquer treacherous mountain terrains in CrossCar, an adrenaline-fueled off-road adventure demanding expert balance and precision. Master realistic physics as you race over tricky landscapes, avoiding flips and crashes. Maintain speed, control, and bravery, and prove you have what it takes to dominate the rugged trails.

CrossCar keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge.
